meta.hermes_install: pip install -e . in $DAMNBOT_CACHE/hermes-venv (editable path; non-editable wheel/sdist refused by setup.py guard); 37 s with an empty pip cache
meta.source: $DAMNBOT_CACHE/f2-inputs/hermes-src (vendored, no .git; identity from the F0 baseline)
meta.harness: bench/f3/hermes_measure.py (PTY + timestamped loopback OpenAI SSE + turnkey/build timing)
meta.host_note: workstation measurement, not the Q14 reference machine

hermes_detail: classic prompt_toolkit REPL (`hermes chat --cli`) and the real Ink TUI (`hermes --tui`) under a PTY

first_token.surface: classic prompt_toolkit REPL (`hermes chat --cli`) under a PTY
first_token.method: T0 = fake provider writes the first streaming content frame carrying F3TOKEN; T1 = F3TOKEN visible in PTY output
first_token.difference_from_damnbot: Hermes runs the turn in a detached local gateway, so T0→T1 includes a gateway hop and rich-console rendering; the Damn-Bot harness measures the in-process TUI path.

startup.method: T0 = before pty fork/exec of `hermes chat --cli`; first_output = first PTY byte; prompt_ready = 'Welcome to Hermes Agent! Type your message' seen

cold.note: includes starting the detached gateway; excluded from the 20 warm samples

cli_repl.note: classic-REPL numbers were measured in the earlier CLI pass over the same checkout; this pass added the Ink TUI.

tui.transport: Node/Ink bundle spawns `python -m tui_gateway.entry`; newline-delimited JSON-RPC over stdio

runtime_env.note: The launcher's PM path tried to provision its own Node under HERMES_HOME and failed (libatomic.so.1 missing; sudo unavailable), so the system Node 22 from PATH is pinned explicitly. This is a setup limitation, not a TUI requirement.

first_token.method: T0 = fake provider writes the first streaming content frame carrying F3TOKEN; T1 = F3TOKEN visible in the TUI's PTY output
first_token.note: each sample starts a fresh Node app and Python gateway; only the OS caches are warm

first_frame.method: T0 = before pty fork/exec of `hermes --tui`; first_frame = the first painted chrome frame ('summoning hermes'); first_byte = first PTY byte (Ink's initial mouse-mode reset); prompt_ready = the intro/tool list ('Available Tools') that carries the composer

cold.note: fresh HERMES_HOME: first session and gateway; excluded from the warm samples

build.note: npm's cache lives under the build work directory: the first sample filled it, the next two reused it. A root `npm ci` fails on this host because node-pty (apps/desktop, tests-js) has no linux-x64 prebuild and no g++ is installed; the TUI workspace does not use it.

tui.difference_from_damnbot: Hermes renders through Ink over a separate Python gateway process, so T0→T1 includes an extra IPC hop; Damn-Bot renders in-process.

clean.method: fresh `python -m venv` + `pip install --no-cache-dir -e <hermes-src>` (deps downloaded from PyPI; venv creation included)

incremental.method: same venv, comment appended to hermes_cli/version_info.py, `pip install --no-cache-dir --no-deps -e <hermes-src>`

buildtime.note: Python packaging has no compile step; clean install is dominated by dependency download/wheel extraction. Measured on the workstation network, not a clean 10 Mbit/s VM.

dimensions.error_informatif: supplementary: 8 common Hermes failure scenarios captured in results/hermes-errors-868b9f244f.json; not a substitute for human raters
